headline: Türkiye Foreign Tourist Arrivals Rise to 5.4 Million in October
summary: Official figures showed Türkiye hosted 5.4 million international visitors in October, sustaining tourism revenue inflows.
why: Tourism represents one of Türkiye's primary sources of foreign currency earnings and service-sector employment.

impacts.name: Türkiye
impacts.why: Foreign tourist arrivals grew to 5.4 million in October, supporting service economic data.
